title: SE implementation scratchpad - Pine Ridge Bank
content:
Date: 2025-02-04
Purpose: working scratchpad for SE implementation + TODOs for Pine Ridge Bank private deployment

Quick summary:
- Customer: Pine Ridge Bank (regional bank, heavy regulatory controls, must be behind bank VPC, KMS/HSM for keys).
- Goal: private Redwood deployment (VPC) with dedicated capacity initially for 50 rps peak, then autoscale to handle bursts up to 150 rps. Latency SLO: p95 < 300ms for 512-token chat responses.
- Timeline: MVP infra by 2025-02-18, canary with internal traffic 2025-02-25, customer pilot early March.

Notes from kickoff (2025-01-28) / follow-up call (2025-02-03):
- Pine Ridge security wants: VPC peering + strict SG rules, no public endpoints, KMS for key wrapping, audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance.
- Compliance: must keep logs for 7 years (we need to confirm retention option and cost).
- They will provide a list of allowed IP ranges for SE team and for Redwood egress (if any).
- Preferred GPU: A10G (Nvidia) for cost/latency tradeoff; discuss A100 if model changes.
- Model: start with small LLM (open-LLaMA-ish) quantized to Q4_0 / int8 if quality holds. Evaluate later for larger Llama-2-70B variant if needed.

Action items / To-do (short actionable list):
- [ ] (Maya) Draft network diagram for VPC peering + subnets -> due 2025-02-06. Put diagram in confluence link draft.
- [ ] (Liam) Confirm KMS/HSM integration options and required IAM roles with infra team -> due 2025-02-06.
- [ ] (Rafael) Create initial Dedicated capacity config (min 2 nodes, burst to 6, A10G) and run cost estimate -> due 2025-02-07.
- [ ] (Sofia) Prepare canary rollout steps + rollback criteria; include perf/regression checks -> due 2025-02-10.
- [ ] (Customer) Provide allowed IP ranges + audit retention policy -> requested 2025-02-03.
- [ ] (Maya) Add prompt set for regression evals (10 critical prompts from PR product) -> due 2025-02-12.

Config notes (rough, for infra):
- Private control plane option preferred (customer-managed networking). Need to confirm whether they want fully air-gapped or just VPC peering.
- VPC: two subnets (private-app, private-infra) across 2 AZs. NAT gateway? customer prefers no NAT for outbound, will provide explicit egress routes.
- Peering: set up transit gateway via their network team. Peering CIDR: TBD (customer to provide).
- Security Groups: allow only HTTPS from bank proxy IP ranges to Redwood API instances. SSH to bastion only from SE office IPs (we will avoid routine SSH).
- KMS: use customer-managed CMK in AWS; HSM option flagged as possible later. Ensure we store only encrypted artifact configs.
- Logging: send audit logs to their Splunk (http collector endpoint) + maintain copy in Redwood console (masked tokens). Need ingestion schema from their SRE.

Model / runtime notes:
- Start with model: 'open-lr-7b-compat' (placeholder) -> profile for 512-token median. If latencies too high, switch to q4_0 quant and enable KV cache sharing.
- Inference settings: max_tokens 512, temp 0.0 for deterministic outputs in some flows. Use streaming for UX.
- Batching: recommend continuous batching window 15ms, target batch size 8 to 16 depending on load. For latency-critical routes push to smaller batch size and lower batching window.
- Cache: enable prefix caching for repeated prompts (customer has many templated transactions). Cache encryption: use CMK.

Autoscale / capacity planning (first-pass):
- Target: 50 rps sustained, 150 rps burst. Estimate tokens per request avg: 150 (prompt+response). -> tokens/s ~ 7.5k sustained, burst 22.5k.
- Start nodes: 2 nodes (A10G), each ~ supports ~25 rps for 150-token avg (educated guess). Need perf run to confirm.
- Autoscale policy: min_capacity 2, target_utilization 70%, max_capacity 6, cooldown 90s. Add burst pool option for scheduled windows.
- Cost estimate: Rafael to compute using current price sheet + 20% buffer for quantization unknowns.

Canary / rollout plan (sketch):
1) Internal canary: route 5% internal traffic -> run perf + regression on 100 prompt set (automated).
2) Expand to 20% internal for 24h, monitor errors, latency, cost delta.
3) Pilot with customer sandbox traffic at 10% -> collect logs + human review.
4) Full cutover after 72h stable.
Rollback triggers: error rate > 1% sustained for 10min, p95 latency > 500ms, quality regression (BLEU/semantic shift on eval set) beyond threshold.

Testing checklist (manual + automated):
- End-to-end smoke test: auth, request/response, streaming, error handling.
- Regression evals: run prompt set (Maya). Compare outputs vs baseline, flag any semantic drift.
- Security scan: infra IaC scan, dependency SCA.
- Load test: ramp to 150 rps for 30m, check memory/KV cache behavior.
- Observability: ensure tracing headers pass through and show up in Redwood console + forwarded to their Splunk.

Notes / shorthand (things to remember):
- Customer wants 'no PII' in debug logs -> ensure we mask tokens and personal data in logs.
- Use function-calls disabled in initial pilot (they want deterministic text responses). Revisit later.
- Keep canary config as code in repo: github.com/redwood-inference/pine-ridge-config (PR-78 currently open).
- Need legal review for data residency (bank asks logs stored in us-east-1 only). Contact legal if non-US artifact required.

Open questions (to resolve ASAP):
- Q1: Will customer accept Redwood-managed private control plane or must they host entire control plane? (Security asked both options) -> TO: Security call 2025-02-06.
- Q2: Exact allowed egress IP ranges for Splunk ingestion? They will confirm with network team.
- Q3: Does the bank require a dedicated HSM (YubiHSM / CloudHSM)? If yes, procurement lead time ~6 weeks.

Meeting notes (short verbatim points):
- "We need audit logs for 7 years, immutable if possible" - Compliance
- "We don't want our traffic transiting public internet" - Network
- "Can you provide sample PII masking rules?" - Product security -> attach sample rules (Maya)

Next immediate steps (this week):
- Network diagram (Maya) + send to Pine Ridge network for initial review.
- KMS integration options doc (Liam) + call with their infra (schedule).
- Dedicated config + cost estimate (Rafael).
- Prep baseline evals + prompt set (Maya).

Random notes / scratch lines (keep):
- CLI to bootstrap test: redwoodctl deploy --env pine-ridge --private-control-plane --nodes 2 --gpu a10g --config pr-pilot.yaml
- pr-pilot.yaml: quant: q4_0, cache_prefix: enabled, log_forwarder: splunk-http(s)
- If latency > target: try lowering batch window -> 10ms, increase nodes, or switch model to smaller param count.

End of scratchpad.

(Will move finalized items to confluence page once validated)
